brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu is entering a sensitive election period and needs new political credentials to rebrand himself as a security strongman capable of imposing his will by force, Shehab Wire reported. The Israeli prime minister faces pressure to demonstrate strength ahead of voting.

The threat Netanyahu poses extends beyond Gaza alone. His pursuit of electoral gains is driving heightened regional confrontation as he attempts to present himself to Israeli voters as a decisive security leader capable of enforcing his conditions through military power.
